items.rationale: Frost fracture of a fitting inside the building is covered under 2.4.4 and 7.1.9; priced at the reference level of about 52.
This is a connection element that had to be renewed with the fractured fitting (7.1.9); reference level about 27.
Labour on the covered pipe repair is indemnified under 7.1.7(f); 3 h x ~100.
Unspecified consumables are treated like the undertaking's small materials or surcharges; this line type was declined in all earlier cases.
One attendance per undertaking is covered (7.1.11); the same wording family paid about 38-44.
Equipment used for leak location is covered under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2, within the EUR 2,500 cap; reference about 15-20.

items.description: Facade damage from frozen internal escape (lump sum)
items.rationale: Render saturated by escaping water that then froze is covered under 2.4.3 without the optional frost peril. However, this line is vague and may duplicate the itemised work.
Taking off failed render on the affected area is covered (7.1.7(a), 2.4.3); the price is a moderate estimate.
Re-forming the substrate on the affected area is covered (7.1.7(c)); reference 35-41.
This unspecified extra work cannot be allocated to an affected part (9.6, 7.1.12), so it is likely declined.
Covered substrate preparation on the affected area; reference 25-37.
The finish system, with the coats it requires, is covered (7.1.7(d)); reference 41-81.
Drying needed before the repair is covered (7.1.7(c)); reference >=233.
Priming of the affected area is covered; reference >=108.
Labour on the covered facade repair is indemnified (7.1.7(f)); 5 h x ~55.
A flat charge that prices no work is excluded under 3.6(b) and 7.1.12; it was declined in all earlier cases.
